subject.title: Feature: Graph-aware loop detection for sessions_send (triangular/polygonal cascades bypass maxPingPongTurns)

question: Should OpenClaw core block any `sessions_send` route that revisits an agent in the same propagated chain, or should graph-cycle protection be configurable or narrower?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible, but the requested fix changes core multi-agent coordination semantics and can reject previously allowed revisit patterns.

options.title: Block repeated agents in-chain
options.body: Adopt the linked fix direction: carry visited-agent provenance and fail the send before delivery when the target has already participated in the chain.

options.title: Make strict cycle blocking opt-in
options.body: Keep current behavior by default and add an explicit strict loop-protection mode only if maintainers want compatibility for existing multi-agent topologies.

options.title: Reject graph blocking
options.body: Leave only pairwise `maxPingPongTurns` in core and handle complex coordination loops through agent design or deployment policy.

recommendation.title: Block repeated agents in-chain
recommendation.body: Adopt the linked fix direction: carry visited-agent provenance and fail the send before delivery when the target has already participated in the chain.
